systemic_note: Three systemic causes. (1) 26.3-form carry-over: the prepare folder names (G06), the aquifer config object (G09), the material-rule name (G11), the spawn-target named densities (G12), the density cache/shifted-noise arms (G13), 11 feature types + the nether carver (G14), random_offset (G16), the sculk cursor/tags (G05/G07/G08), the snow-tag names (G02), the f32 pipeline (G17). (2) The construction cascade G06->G13->G11->G12 with G09 silent behind: no 1.21.11 world generates at all; every downstream defect is latent behind it, and the cascade originates in the template (1.21.10 inherited it wholesale). (3) Half-done 1.21.11 oracle adaptations: ChunkGeneration is the one correct adaptation (passes); the others adapted toward assumed 1.21.11 APIs that the jar contradicts (ChunkPos.pack, addStaticLayers, re-added getNextEntityId, wrong ctor arities). The 1.21.10 report's O08 framing is corrected: RegistryLayer.WORLD etc. exist in NEITHER 1.21.10 NOR 1.21.11.
